title: Meigetsu Select cauliflower (Meigetsu Select F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Meigetsu Select cauliflower is an F1 hybrid cauliflower variety from Ramgo. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Meigetsu Select cauliflower is an F1 hybrid cauliflower variety, also sold or known as Meigetsu Select F1 or Meigetsu cauliflower. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Ramgo.

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Meigetsu Select cauliflower is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Meigetsu Select F1 or Meigetsu cauliflower, this is the same cauliflower. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [cauliflower variety finder](/crop-varieties/cauliflower), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).
Key facts about Meigetsu Select cauliflower

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit cauliflower fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [black rot of cabbage](/diseases/black-rot), [cabbage webworm](/pests/cabbage-webworm), [clubroot](/diseases/clubroot), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** 40 to 50 days after transplanting.
**Fruit:** Curd: bright white and even, about 600 g.
Upright leaves that shade the curd well.
Tolerant to heat and rain stress (Ramgo claim).

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: one of two cauliflowers on Ramgo's professional line, the only evidence found is Ramgo's listing. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual cauliflower on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Meigetsu Select cauliflower
Cauliflower needs cool nights to form a tight white curd, so it is a highland crop. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Meigetsu Select F1 the same as Meigetsu Select?
items.a: Yes. Meigetsu Select F1 is another name for Meigetsu Select. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Meigetsu Select?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
